mechanism: Tobramycin is nephrotoxic and can impair renal function, potentially leading to increased duloxetine accumulation and toxicity; duloxetine may increase bleeding risk through platelet inhibition in patients with compromised renal function.
action: Monitor renal function closely with baseline and periodic creatinine/BUN; assess for duloxetine toxicity signs; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; ensure adequate hydration during tobramycin therapy.
